canonical_name: Pulsant Edinburgh campus (SC-1 South Gyle, SC-2, SC-3)
summary: Pulsant operates three interconnected colocation data centres in west Edinburgh (SC-1 at South Gyle plus the nearby SC-2 and SC-3 facilities), treated here as one campus record. Combined advertised power is in the mid-to-high single-digit megawatts; SC-1 alone advertises 3.4 MW IT load with 600+ racks. Pulsant is owned by Antin Infrastructure Partners (since 2021).
maturity_explanation: All three facilities are actively marketed as operating colocation sites on Pulsant's own website and third-party directories (Data Center Map, Baxtel) as of July 2026.
unknowns: Exact combined campus power (directory figures for SC-1 range from 3.4 MW IT load to 6.6 MW; brief figure of ~9.6 MW combined not independently confirmed)
Year each facility first opened (SC-1 dates to the ScoLocate era, late 1990s/2000s; not verified)
Current utilisation and expansion plans for the Edinburgh campus
